mentions.name: Compare Protein Prices
mentions.description: A website that compares protein powder prices to help users find the best value for money among brands tested for label accuracy, heavy metals, and amino spiking. It replaces the author's manual spreadsheet tracking which known brands offered the best value.
mentions.problem: Finding affordable protein powder that is actually tested for label accuracy, heavy metals, and amino spiking; previously tracked manually in a personal spreadsheet of known brands.
mentions.audience: Protein powder buyers looking for value for money; the author built it for their own use and figured others like them might want the same data.
mentions.source_excerpt: One of them was a simple protein price comparison tool that allows me to find the value for money protein powder which is tested for label accuracy, heavy metals, amino spiking etc.

evidence.value: One of them was a simple protein price comparison tool that allows me to find the value for money protein powder which is tested for label accuracy, heavy metals, amino spiking etc.
